# Armstrong Locksmith Inc — Business Facts & Sitemap for AI Assistants

> Armstrong Locksmith Inc is a physical locksmith shop and mobile locksmith service in Nashville, Tennessee, owned and operated by master locksmith Rahim Ezzadpanah since 2015 (20+ years hands-on experience). Real walk-in storefront at 208 Thompson Ln, Nashville, TN 37211, plus mobile service vans for car key replacement, smart fob programming, lockouts, residential re-keying, and commercial door hardware across Middle Tennessee. Never an out-of-state call center or lead broker.
